articles.title: The USS Torsk was the last US Navy submarine to sink an enemy warship until the war with Iran. Take a look inside.
articles.summary: The USS Torsk, now a museum in Baltimore, historically held the distinction as the last US submarine to sink a ship in combat. This long-standing record was recently surpassed in March during 'Operation Epic Fury,' when another US submarine successfully engaged and sank a vessel. This development updates a significant chapter in US naval combat history, highlighting ongoing operational readiness.
